name: OSDataset2.0
description: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and optical imagery are two key remote-sensing modalities in Earth observation, and cross-modal image matching between them is widely applied in tasks such as image fusion, joint interpretation, and high-precision geolocation. In recent years, with the rapid growth of Earth-observation data, the importance of cross-modal image matching between SAR and optical data has become increasingly prominent, and related studies have achieved notable progress.
